title: Bug: ACL v6 tests uplink to downlink direction fails due to wrong configuration
author: AharonMalkin
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

After merging the following PR:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/21155
and enabling ACL tests on v6 only isolated topologies, multiple ACL test cases failed on uplink->downlink side, due to packet loss.

The root cause, as I analyzed, is mentioned in the test_acl.py module:
```
# TODO: These routes don't match the VLAN interface from the T0 topology.
# This needs to be addressed before we can enable the v6 tests for T0
```

The IPv6 routes don't match the VLAN interface configuration for T0 topology, As well as t1 topologies.

The DOWNSTREAM_DST_IP is staticaly set and doesn't exist for the topologies.


### Steps to Reproduce

Run test_acl.py on t0/t1 v6 isolated topologies, with uplink->downlink parameter.

For example:
 test_icmp_match_forwarded[ipv6-ingress-uplink->downlink-default-no_vlan]
 

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual behavior: The packet gets routed via some default or fallback path, ending up on some port (which appears to be an upstream port, not in the expected downstream ports list)

`AssertionError: Received expected packet on port 97 for device 0, but it should have arrived on one of these ports: [0, 8, 108, 120, 128, 136, 144, 152, 160, 168, 176, 184, 16, 192, 200, 208, 216, 224, 232, 240, 248, 256, 264, 24, 272, 280, 288, 296, 304, 312, 320, 332, 340, 352, 32, 360, 368, 376, 384, 392, 400, 408, 416, 424, 432, 40, 440, 448, 456, 48, 56, 64, 72, 80, 88, 100].`

Expected behavior: The traffic routes correctly, tests pass.

linkedPullRequests.author: markx-arista
linkedPullRequests.body:

### Description of PR
<!--

- Please also include relevant motivation and context. Where should reviewer start? background context?
- List any dependencies that are required for this change.
-->

Summary:
t0-isolated-v6-*:
Downstream neighbors are servers connected to VLAN interface. Use DOWNSTREAM_DST_IP_VLAN as dest ips. IPv6 cases have been skipped for t0 since beginning, only fix it for v6 topos now.

t1-isolated-v6-*:
V6 topo files set ipv6_address_pattern: 2064:100:0::%02X%02X:%02X%02X:0/120.
announce_routes.py uses the pattern to generate routes for PTF and pass them to VMs. If it is not set, default pattern 20%02X:%02X%02X:0:%02X::/64 is used.
acl tests use hardcoded dest ip 20c0:a800::1 that is not covered by v6 topo pattern, so packets are forwarded with the default route to upstream VM.
Fix it by changing dest ip for v6 topos, also add acl rules for these dest ips.

With extra ACL rules for v6 topos, also increase timeout for check_rule_counters.
Fixes #21770 

### Type of change

<!--
- Fill x for your type of change.
- e.g.
- [x] Bug fix
-->

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case

- [x] Test case improvement


### Back port request
- [x] 202412
- [x] 202505

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
test_acl.py [ipv6-ingress-uplink->downlink-*] cases failed on v6 topo

#### How did you do it?
Correct DOWNSTREAM_DST_IP for t0/t1-isolated-v6-*. topos, and add corresponding acl rules

#### How did you verify/test it?
Test passed on t0/t1-isolated-v6-*. topos
